## Independent reviewer reproduction

```powershell
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm run test:headless
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
git diff --check
git diff --stat
```

Pass means the focused suite reports 9/9, all sixteen reports are PASS, coverage is 50/50 with zero failures and 800 commands, replay/repeat/reload match, artifact and coverage hashes match the frozen values, full CI/governance pass, nine production gates remain visibly BLOCKED, and Prompt 19 remains `READY_FOR_REVIEW` with no approval metadata.

## Diff summary

Prompt 19 adds a separate TEST_ONLY headless acceptance leaf, sixteen independently authored golden scenarios, a deterministic 50-campaign sweep for the compiled difficulty, fixed replay/reload evidence, fail-closed artifact validation and negative cases, and explicit reporting of every unavailable production gate. It also records the owner-reviewed Prompt 18 commit as its acceptance event and moves governance mutation checks to Prompt 19 without creating a second mutable source of truth.
